lines.say: What if every person on Earth disappeared, right now?
Two seconds later. Cars roll to a stop. Nobody is driving.

lines.cap: Power plants shut down. The lights go out.
lines.say: Day one. The power plants shut down. One by one, the lights go out.

lines.cap: The food goes bad. The rats move in.
lines.say: One week. The food in every shop goes bad. The rats move in.

lines.cap: Weeds crack the road. Deer walk the high street.
lines.say: One year. Weeds crack the road. Deer walk down the high street.
Ten years. The street becomes a meadow. Shop windows fall out.

lines.cap: Roofs cave in. Trees grow through the bakery.
lines.say: One hundred years. Roofs cave in. A tree grows right through the bakery.
One thousand years. The town is a forest. Only broken stone is left.

lines.cap: Ice. Nobody could tell a town was here.
lines.say: Ten thousand years. The ice comes back. Nobody could tell a town was ever here.
Except one thing. A shiny gold tank. Still parked. Not a scratch.
Who parked it? Tell me in the comments.
